data.label: Signed-in user
data.description: Test user in a browser; not provisioned.

data.label: Identity Platform
data.description: Signs users in and issues ID tokens; subject maps to catalog ACL groups.

data.label: Web app
data.description: Authenticated chat UI; shows answers with cited source revisions or an abstention.

data.label: RAG API
data.description: Verifies token, filters by ACL before keyword retrieval, sends only allowed passages to the model, abstains when unsupported, rechecks ACL/revision before returning (suppresses on revocation).

data.label: Document catalog
data.description: Documents, keyword terms, explicit ACLs and current revisions; deletes remove entries.

data.label: Gemini model
data.description: Writes grounded answers. Model ID, region availability and quotas unverified; mocked in local test.

data.label: Content operator
data.description: Uploads, updates and deletes synthetic documents with ACL metadata.

data.label: Source documents
data.description: Private versioned bucket for synthetic documents.

data.label: Indexer
data.description: Triggered by Eventarc on create/update/delete; tokenizes text and conditionally writes revision + ACL to catalog.

data.label: Audit logs
data.description: Records denials, abstentions, citations and suppressions without document text.

brief.application: Use Google Cloud for this synthetic architecture qualification. Answer questions over a small synthetic document collection with citations. Include ingestion, retrieval, model runtime, identity enforcement and an authenticated application. Use bounded keyword retrieval for this first test and keep all source permissions. Acceptance criteria: Denied documents never reach the model; Known questions cite current source revisions; Unsupported questions abstain; Updates and deletions change retrieval; Revocation during generation suppresses the answer. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

requirements.statement: Passages from documents the user cannot access never get sent to the model.
requirements.rationale: Leaking denied content into prompts breaks source permissions.
requirements.basis: User: Denied documents never reach the model

requirements.statement: Answers to known questions cite the current source revisions; unsupported questions abstain.
requirements.rationale: Stale or missing citations make answers untrustworthy.
requirements.basis: User: Known questions cite current source revisions; Unsupported questions abstain

requirements.statement: Updates and deletions change retrieval, and revoking access during generation suppresses the answer.
requirements.rationale: Without this, users could keep seeing deleted or revoked content.

decisions.subject: design.gcp-permission-aware-keyword-rag-qualification
decisions.title: GCP permission-aware keyword RAG qualification
decisions.context: Scope: synthetic documents only; bounded keyword retrieval (not vector search). Users sign in via Identity Platform; Cloud Run web app calls a Cloud Run RAG API that filters by ACL before retrieval, cites revisions, abstains when unsupported and rechecks authorization before returning. Ingestion: operator uploads to Cloud Storage; Eventarc triggers an indexing Cloud Run service writing documents, ACLs and revisions to Firestore. Assumptions: region not selected; model ID, quotas and availability unverified; no native GCP Terraform generator exists for this path, so it is engineering-required.
